name: Moto E22

Platform.Operating system: E22/E22s/E32 (India): Android 12, E22i: Android 12 (Go Edition), E32/E32s: Android 11
Platform.CPU: E22/E22i/E22s/E32 (India)/E32s: MediaTek MT6765V/CB Helio G37 (12 nm), octa-core (4×2.3 GHz Cortex-A53 & 4×1.8 GHz Cortex-A53), E32: Unisoc T606 (12 nm), octa-core (2×1.6 GHz Cortex-A75 & 6×1.6 GHz Cortex-A55)

Memory.RAM: E22/E32s: 3/4 GB, E22i: 2 GB, E22s/E32: 4 GB, LPDDR4X

Cameras.Rear camera: E22/E22i/E22s: 16 MP, 26 mm (wide), 1.0 µm, PDAF + 2 MP, (depth sensor), E32/E32s: 16 MP, 26 mm (wide), 1.0 µm, PDAF + 2 MP, (macro) + 2 MP, (depth sensor), E32 (India): 50 MP, 26 mm, (wide), 0.64 µm, PDAF + 2 MP, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps

Battery.Battery: All models: non-removable, Li-Po, E22/E22i: 4020 mAh, E22s/E32/E32s: 5000 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, 3.5 mm Audio jack, Bluetooth 5.0 (A2DP, LE), FM radio, NFC (E22 3/32 GB), Wi-Fi 802.11 a (except E32)/b/g/n/ac (except E32) (dual-band (except E32), Wi-Fi Direct (E32), hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, Galileo
